answer: Shards are assigned from the oasis graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The plume assignment is published and hollow records each panel. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1162 impostors cost 650 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
